chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Abu Talib Abd Allah ibn al-Salt from Ibn Abi Umayr who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) used to recite in the two rak'ahs after the 'Isha prayer - Al-Waqi'ah and "Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad".
The Sheikh (may Allah have mercy on him) said: And he should go to his bed until he finishes saying it, and he should not leave the Siwak.
ai.seo_question: What Surahs did Imam al-Sadiq (AS) recite in the two rak'ahs after Isha prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from Tahdhib al-Ahkam highlights the specific Sunnah of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to recite Surah Al-Waqi'ah and Surah Al-Ikhlas in the two voluntary rak'ahs after 'Isha, a practice widely adopted in Shia devotional life. Sheikh al-Tusi’s commentary clarifies that this routine continues until one retires to bed, linking spiritual preparation with physical hygiene through the continued use of the Siwak. This emphasizes the holistic nature of night prayers, combining remembrance of divine unity and provision with prophetic traditions of cleanliness.
